gold_decisions.identity_explanation: The gold issue concerns the unproved converse direction of an equality characterization, including proving the optimal singular-value value from an admissible three-cluster configuration. ISSUE-001 concerns a separate false lemma about pairwise distinct singular directions and does not recognize the missing converse.

Both entries identify that Lemma le falsely claims pairwise distinct right-singular directions: pairwise non-collinear square vectors can have collinear pair sums, causing coincident singular directions. ISSUE-001 supplies a concrete counterexample and the same weaker repair that at least one direction differs.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The lemma's implication from pairwise non-collinear squared vectors to pairwise distinct pair-sum, and hence right-singular, directions is false; only a weaker non-all-identical conclusion is justified.
